lines.1: 「Do not come back until you have found ten left-hand-drive cars.」
lines.5: Damn. There were more domestic cars around than I expected.
lines.6: 「Pant, pant, pant... Late May is already hot.」
lines.7: Instead of cooling my head, the humidity had cooked it.
lines.10: Ugh. School started again tomorrow, and I couldn't be bothered.
